verdict.rationale: Kong documents a RESTful Admin API that configures the gateway, alongside the Kong Manager web UI. It also publishes OpenAPI specs for its APIs, and several Konnect features (Notification Hub, audit-log webhook status) are documented as manageable in both the UI and the API, backed by Terraform, decK and kongctl. However, there is no explicit statement or independent check that every UI action has an API equivalent. missing for 10: explicit documented UI/API parity guarantee, independent or hands-on corroboration of full coverage, a supported general-purpose Konnect SDK (the Go SDK is a prototype).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
